'''Rakazzak beasts''' were three-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-tall arachnids from the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Cartoon_Yuzzums_on_rakazzaks_01.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Yuzzums on rakazzak beasts]]
They were carnivorous and spun webs to trap prey. They also actively hunted by rearing back on their hind legs and using their forelegs to trap prey. Their long legs gave them exceptional speed and kept their riders out of range of attacks from the ground.

They were often preyed upon by [[Condor dragon/Legends|condor dragons]].

==History==
[[Morag]] captured two of the beasts and used them to hold an infant [[Phlog/Legends|phlog]]. Some [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzums]] used domesticated rakazzak beasts as mounts.
